question: If the length of the wire is doubled and cross section area of the wire is halved then the resistivity of the material is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**unchanged**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The resistivity (ρ) of a material is a property that depends only on the material itself and is independent of its dimensions.
 
• When the length of a wire is doubled and the cross-sectional area is halved, these changes affect the **resistance **(R) of the wire, not the resistivity.
 
• Since resistivity (ρ) is constant for a given material and does not depend on the wire's length or cross-sectional area, it will remain the same regardless of these changes.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is that **the resistivity of the material is unchanged.**
